purpose: Re-audit the exhausted three-session frontier after the terminal Tushare stock_st source attempt, correct a date-only suspension screen that ignored zero-volume placeholders, stop the suspend_d resumption candidate on an intentionally optimistic no-return capacity upper bound, and select at most one newly independent mechanism available to the existing 3000-point account before requesting a provider row.

initial_date_only_screen.reason: BaoStock can retain a daily row for a suspended stock-session with nonpositive activity. Therefore absence of a missing date is not an upper bound on official full-day suspension or resumption events. The date-only result is preserved here only to prevent accidental reuse.

corrected_input_contract.possible_full_day_suspension_definition: Every missing local stock-session or row with nonfinite or nonpositive raw_volume is counted as a possible full-day suspension.
corrected_input_contract.possible_resumption_definition: The first positive finite raw_volume local session immediately after one or more possible full-day suspension sessions.
optimistic_biases: missing or malformed source activity is counted as suspension instead of rejected
left-censored spells beginning at a point-in-time holding interval boundary are retained
no official suspend_d confirmation is required
corrected_input_contract.fixed_cohort_grid: Every third local session after each complete three-session block, producing 566 non-overlapping signal dates.

corrected_suspend_resumption_no_return_c.interpretation: This rejects the exact full-day suspension-duration resumption candidate for the fixed three-session cross-sectional protocol. It does not prove that suspend_d lacks events or that resumption returns are negative.
prohibited_actions: request suspend_d rows for this rejected mechanism
treat the invalid date-only zero result as evidence
add intraday suspensions, widen event age, use overlapping cohorts, or combine sparse events to manufacture capacity
read prices or returns for this candidate

official_documentation_screen.reason: Each official exchange-warning interface requires 6000 points, while the authorized account has 3000. The pages do not document a continuous 2019-2025 archive.
Opening and closing auction data use separate permissions unrelated to points; the current authorization does not include them.
The official page states that premarket share-capital data require separately opened permission unrelated to points.
A 2000-point account has only ten trial requests per day; formal history requires 8000 points. It also overlaps the already completed analyst-rating and performance-expectation branches.
The interface requires 6000 points. Even perfect 2019-2025 monthly coverage supplies at most 84 distinct monthly event anchors, below the fixed 200-cohort gate.
The interfaces require 6000 and 8000 points and were introduced only in late 2024, so they cannot satisfy the fixed five-year gate.
Shanghai and Shenzhen investor Q&A are a separate paid entitlement rather than a points interface, and the current account has not purchased it.

daily_basic requires 2000 points, supports daily historical extraction, documents total_share and free_share, and updates after the close. Structural freely tradable supply is economically different from price paths, PB valuation, order flow, and the terminal realized-unlock event shock.

selected_candidate.economic_mechanism: A smaller freely tradable share base relative to total shares creates structural supply scarcity. The hypothesis fixes greater scarcity as the higher short-horizon score because a given demand impulse is spread across less freely tradable supply.
selected_candidate.eligibility: total_share and free_share must both be finite and strictly positive, with free_share no greater than total_share; every other row is excluded and counted without clipping or imputation
selected_candidate.availability: after the documented same-session 15:00-17:00 update for entry at the next local session open
selected_candidate.absent_or_invalid_value_policy: missing; never zero, one, clipped, or filled

economic_independence.versus_positive_book_to_market: PB is a price-to-book valuation state; free-float scarcity uses only share counts and requests no price, book value, or valuation field.
economic_independence.versus_restricted_share_unlock_pressure: The terminal unlock factor was a dated realized supply-release event and ranked event magnitude. This candidate is a daily structural state of freely tradable supply and does not request unlock schedules, holder counts, market values, or returns.
economic_independence.versus_liquidity_and_volume: The candidate requests no volume, turnover, amount, market capitalization, or price. A separate no-return rank-correlation gate must still reject it if the structural state behaves as a near-synonym of an existing liquidity field.
economic_independence.same_provider_is_not_same_mechanism: The prior daily_basic PB snapshot does not contain total_share or free_share and cannot be reused or reinterpreted. A new exact-field contract is required.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact source, fields, formula, direction, timing, invalid-row, completeness, atomicity, capacity, and uniqueness contract before any free-float provider row
implement exact-field fetching and a one-session 2026-07-13 acceptance with no price or return access
require a positive sub-6000 all-market response, unique keys, range-valid shares, at least 95 percent point-in-time buyable coverage, at least 50 names, and at least two factor values
only after acceptance, run one atomic 2019-2025 full-session snapshot under the unchanged contract
run the fixed no-return 200-cohort five-year capacity gate before loading comparison fields
only after capacity passes, compare against every existing same-session factor using the fixed absolute median daily Spearman below 0.8 gate
freeze a separate one-time return diagnostic only if source, capacity, and uniqueness all pass
prohibited_actions: request close, turnover, volume_ratio, PE, PB, PS, dividend yield, market capitalization, float_share, limit_status, price, or return fields
substitute float_share for free_share or switch from the frozen scarcity direction to free-float abundance
derive a change, unlock event, interaction, size residual, or demand confirmation after observing source values
reuse the terminal PB snapshot as if it contained share counts
read returns, aggregate, score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before all no-return gates pass
